reviews.title: A Great Visit
reviews.text: Tuscany is a welcoming fun place to visit.  The games are fun and accommodations are roomy and clean. The beds were comfortable and appreciated having a coffee maker in the room.

reviews.title: The Best Gamble to take while in Vegas Baby!
reviews.text: The Tuscany Suites and Casino is a wonderful place to come for your Vegas getaway. It's a close and easy walk to the strip or a short uber/taxi drive and close enough to Harry Reid international without the noise of the airplanes.  Sometimes "you get what you pay for" can come into play, but I was VERY pleasantly surprised that this wonderfully affordable hotel was beautifully manicured, had large spacious and clean rooms, and a great variety of restaurants, bars, and cafes!  Not to mention, if I didn't want to go to the strip to gamble, the casino on site had so much to offer.  I already told my husband that we're coming back and staying here because next time I also want to enjoy the beautiful pool and spa area they offer. You will not be disappointed. Save the $ for shows, shopping, and more and stay at the Tuscany Suites & Casino. It's the best gamble you'll make while in Vegas!

reviews.title: Nice stay off the Strip
reviews.text: Nice room: large, clean, with fridge, great bed, and quiet. No microwave in room but could have requested one. Didn’t use the pools but they looked inviting and well kept. Distance from Strip was OK if you are willing to do the walk (about 15+ minutes).

reviews.title: Awesome Stay!
reviews.text: In town for a concert we selected this hotel as it was off the strip and less costly. We were a family of four adults and the room was impressive as it was quite spacious. The room consisted of two full-size beds, a living room with a nice sized couch, armchair, office chair/desk and a dining table, TV. There was a kitchenette with fridge and coffee maker (Keurig) and wet bar but no microwave (but we did see severalmicrowaves locked up in the maids’ closet at end of hall). The bathroom consisted of a square-shaped size shower (single person size), a toilet, bathtub and vanity. The room was carpeted (as opposed to a wooden or linoleum floor). They had a nice pool, bar and breakfast restaurant on site, too. The main pool had loud punk music being piped in but the nearby lap pool did not. They had poolside drink service, too. We all loved the small scale of the resort (three stories) and the ability to park close to your room. One evening we walked to the Hotel Cosmopolitan (30 minutes) passing Paris-Las Vegas, Planet Hollywood and Bellagio along the strip. The hotel staff was very accommodating, especially Shaun, the manager at check out. We would definitely come back here again.

reviews.title: Vegas hidden gem
reviews.text: Great valueVery clean 10 mins Walk to strip Very nice restaurants with GREAT prices Vegas hidden gem for sure The grounds landscaping is beautiful The pool and hottub are heated and open all year round

reviews.title: Best place to stay
reviews.text: There always clean and very affordable. The staff are very friendly and willing to help. If you plan on staying in Vegas I'd recommend staying here.

reviews.title: not a better place to stay.
reviews.text: for me...it truly is the best place to stay. location is killer. the rooms are huge. live music 7 nights a week. (no cover) name 1 hotel that provides a coffee maker (with coffee pods) a refrigerator, and a microwave.(ask for one, upon arrival) I can tell you ...none! the grounds are immaculate. the pools stay open til 10pm. the buildings are only 3 stories high mand with the rooms being so big, you have only 10 rooms per floor. the eats, are very good. and Cafe Bottega has thee ..best coffee! truly, you cannot go wrong choosing this establishment. it truly is a throwback to the way, Vegas used to be. treated like royalty....but without the ransom!

reviews.title: VERY DISAPPOINTED
reviews.text: We arrived tired in the evening after a long day of travel.Check in was perfect and Noah was friendly and helpfulThe room assigned was removed from the parking areas so relatively quietWe retired early due to the travel and time difference w/o checking out the roomWe awoke to find that our coffee maker was broken, we next noticed the dead bolt doesn't work on our door, we also found out the vault was already locked and un-usable.We called for service before leaving the htel to report these things to front desk.She stated they would send someone out to fix these things while we were out exploring.  While speaking with the operator I asked where the complimentary water bottle was. She stated only (casino) VIPs were given complimentary water bottles. RME gasp.9 hours later after returning to the room we found NOTHING had been touched.It was dinner time and our show was to follow - on the way to the dnner we again reported these issues to the front desk . . . instead of making an effort to fix right away the assistance mgr on duty tried to accuse use of not reporting these things in a timely manner.  We were comped a 3rd of the over priced dinner in the hotel's restaurant which wasn't worth the 3rd let alone the full price.Overall, I'd recommend buyer beware at this hotel - not terrible but certainly DOES NOT meet expectations or norms for service and accomodation.

reviews.title: Unhappy this Vacation at the Tuscany
reviews.text: My husband and I have been staying at the Tuscany for more than 15 years. This was the first time we were disappointed in our stay. The rooms are always nicely furnished and clean. The pool is great and a good way to relax in the sun. We have been to the strip but rather enjoy just being at the Tuscany, The restaurants are good except the prices are rather high. I felt the air conditioning in the casino was way too high because I was freezing most of the time. I had a bad experience in the casino where someone stole my ticket from the machine for $88.17. I was treated like a criminal when I first had staff come to the slot machine when I said my ticket was gone. Eventually they checked cameras and found some woman cashed it out then walked out of the casino. I felt that they could have helped more or compensated me for my loss. I do have to say they were helpful when we checked in because I have cancer and they did give me a room one the first floor of the building we always stay in. I'm disappointed with our vacation at the Tuscany this year because I may not be able to make another year because of my health.

reviews.title: Great location and value, perfect for business travel
reviews.text: Great option within walking distance of the Venetian, Paris, Caesar's, the Sphere, BattleBots Arena, and the Atomic Museum. Room was large with a living area. Grounds and room clean. I stayed for a conference, so value, comfort, and quiet were my primary concerns. The rooms are in a completely separate building from the bar and casino, so sleep was good. Marilyn's Cafe also provided a solid diner breakfast.

reviews.title: Fun times.
reviews.text: Need those Tuscany coupons back. Need the pens back. Rooms look great. Property is always great. I will see ya'll again in the near future.

reviews.title: Nice hotel with competitive price
reviews.text: It is a very nice hotel overall and I would choose to stay again, but we were assigned to a far corner, which was a bit inconvenient, plus the room AC was noisy the first night, the vents were not working inside the bathroom/toilet room, and the broken picture frame was not cleaned up after room service.The temporary road construction made the stay a little bit challenging also when going to the strip or riding buses

reviews.title: Affordable Full Las Vegas Experience
reviews.text: Nice to be slightly off the busy strip but still very close at the same time. Very close to the Sphere and easy to navigate to and from

reviews.title: Relaxing, enjoyable and hope to return soon.
reviews.text: There is not much I can say when the service is excellent from walking in the door to leaving after the visit. Front desk went very well. The suite was perfect, clean and spacious. The Bodega smoothies were addictive and tasty. The staff at Marylands were very pleasant,  efficient and the food was tasty and a good value.

reviews.title: Overall wonderful place to stay. Made us feel welcomed and appreciated.
reviews.text: Such a wonderful property, exceptionally friendly staff, beautiful accommodations, Well priced dining options, located within long walking distance from many places, but with a rental car it was perfect.

reviews.title: For the cost  very clean and comfortable.
reviews.text: Reserved two days.Casino does not pay and I gambled more than I should have. Hotel and restaurants where outstanding very nice hospitality ended up staying four days and gambled elsewhere.

reviews.title: Better than expected. Loved my stay would stay again!
reviews.text: I would stay again. I loved the room (executive suite in building H by main pool and close to gym, lobby) and the resort. Beautiful trees, pools, setting. Off the beaten path. Easy walk to the Sphere.  Construction on strip a real pain - I avoided as much as possible. Plan time to enjoy the resort itself if you would like to just relax. I did & am so glad I did vs stress of navigating the strip! I enjoyed choose salad at Pub 365, panini at I think Bogetta? And the entertainment in the lounge bar area was really good! Clean, good service. They do need more bellman though to manage all the activity.

reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: Fantastic gem just steps off the hussle & bussle of the strip. Large resort complex with many buildings.  Every room is huge and all furnishings are in Fantastic condition. Bars & restaurants have very affordable happy hour deals. Casino has low minimums.  All staff is very nice. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: SPHERE and RAIDERS Weekend Fun in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Tuscany is the perfect hotel and awesome location for ez walk to THE SPHERE and other casinos and a short Uber ride to RAIDERS game!! It is also perfect for a one and done casino hotel restaurant entertainment pool experience if you don’t want to leave the property.

reviews.title: Fabulous accommodations.
reviews.text: Best place in Vegas to stay. The grounds are beautiful and all of the employees are very helpful and kind.  We will stay at Tuscany Suites on every trip we take.
